daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

The Supreme Court's decision to annul Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka's high school certificate substitute has triggered a major political controversy over the legitimacy of his candidacy and office. Former Coordinating Minister for Political, Legal, and Security Affairs Mahfud MD argued that the MA ruling applies retroactively, and separately stated that the creation of the certificate substitute should be prosecuted criminally. While the General Elections Commission (KPU) responded that the electoral stages have concluded, political parties across the spectrum weighed in, with Gerindra stating the ruling must be taken seriously and calling for resolution through constitutional mechanisms.

  • Political parties have urged the government to evaluate presidential and vice-presidential requirements following the certificate controversy.
  • President Prabowo Subianto gathered hundreds of business leaders from P3MDI and Kadin at Hambalang to hear their input on economic matters.
  • PDI-P secretary Hasto Kristiyanto told party cadres not to be afraid to defend the people amid ongoing political tensions.
  • The Judicial Commission is pushing for an omnibus law on the judiciary to strengthen judicial ethics oversight.
  • The DPD Special Committee on Papua has called on the government to prioritize the safety and recovery of civilian refugees in the region.
  • The Indonesian National Police confirmed that legal proceedings against Dedi Congor continue despite his KPK suspect status.
  • The PKS faction in the Jakarta provincial parliament has demanded that the DKI Jakarta government review plans for the Andrea Bocelli concert.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesia and Uzbekistan have established a joint committee for food security and trade to strengthen bilateral economic cooperation. Separately, Indonesia is seeking market access in China for personalized products, aiming to diversify export opportunities to the world's second-largest economy.

  • President Prabowo urged Indonesian youth to study the nation's history to avoid repeating past mistakes, emphasizing the importance of historical awareness.
  • The Trade Ministry has called on university students to become exporters as part of efforts to boost Indonesia's export capacity.
  • The TNI responded to statements by a DPR member regarding deployment of soldiers to secure demonstrations.

Other

Authorities suspect deliberate arson behind 1,600 hectares of fires in the new capital IKN, marking a significant environmental and security concern for the flagship project. In related environmental law enforcement, the Ministry of Environment and Forestry has designated two companies as suspects in forest fire cases, one from Singapore. The government has ordered nationwide transit safety checks ahead of year-end holidays, including inspection of 2,140 vessels as travel season approaches.

  • State holding company Danantara has clarified that it did not sponsor the TIME100 Next Gala 2026 following public questions about the appearance of its name and logo at the event.
  • Indonesia has urged strict AI risk mitigation in finance and healthcare while seeking to balance innovation with safety.
  • The government is seeking private sector support to achieve 7 percent investment growth targets.
  • Indonesia is weighing imports of 100,000 cattle to achieve milk self-sufficiency as part of food security initiatives.
  • The Ministry of Health has launched a campaign to reduce stigma against children with Down syndrome.
